needscope.reading: Belonging is crowded — Amul and Nandini own inclusive, everyday co-operative warmth, while Dodla sits nearby on regional familiarity. Security is where quality-and-hygiene players compete, with Hatsun's Arokya and Jersey anchored on reliability and richness. Heritage sits between Belonging and Security today, but the open whitespace is Power — active, farmer-fresh nutritional strength that no competitor has claimed as their own emotional pole.

cb: Bought as the dependable daily home-delivery or store milk — a routine, not a decision.
Chosen for the family's tea, curd and children's milk; rarely credited with active nutritional benefit.
Under-indexed with younger 25-44 women who default to Amul/Nandini or trade to specialist protein and A2 options.
db: Actively chosen for its farmer-fresh, daily-checked purity across milk, curd, paneer and value-added range.
Trade-up within franchise: standard milk to fortified, high-protein and premium fresh variants.
Named by 25-44 women as their considered choice for the family's daily nutrition, not just a habit.
cb_ca_db_da.ca_quote: Heritage is the fresh local milk we've always had at home — reliable, decent quality, nothing to think about.
ca_declarative: Trust is quiet and taken for granted.
A habit, not an active choice.
cb_ca_db_da.da_quote: Heritage is pure milk straight from our farmers, checked every day — real strength for my family.
da_declarative: Active pride in pure sourcing, not passive reliance.
The purity I choose because I understand it.
cb_ca_db_da.caption: The desired attitude layers active, farmer-pure nutritional strength on top of Heritage's existing trust — the everyday-freshness equity stays intact, a new thread of purpose is added.
cb_ca_db_da.shift_line: From dependable local freshness to chosen farmer-pure nutrition.

fields.smp: Heritage is pure nutrition, straight from the farmer, checked every day.

smp_defence.why_collapses: Claims trust and taste, but its co-operative scale distances it from a visible farmer-to-you freshness promise checked daily.
Owns state-backed reliability, but leans on institutional trust rather than active daily quality-checked purity as a nutrition claim.
Claims hygiene and consistency, but frames it as process safety, not farmer-source purity translated into nutrition.
Claims farmer freshness regionally, but lacks the masterbrand nutrition equity to own 'pure nutrition' credibly.
Claims richness and freshness, but competes on indulgent quality, not everyday farmer-pure nutritional strength.
